list.snippet: Alpha-H Firming Peptide Body Oil: Formulated with Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, macadamia oil, and microalgae oil to target fine lines and sagging. Prices range from £23.90 to £31.99 for a 100ml bottle via retailers like Alpha-H UK, Cloud 10 Beauty, and Cult Beauty.
Coco & Eve Firming & Tan Prolonging Peptide Body Oil: Uses biomimetic peptides and tropical oils to extend natural tans and nourish the skin. Prices start around £26.00 at Coco & Eve UK.
Multi-Peptide Body Oil for Crepey Skin: Budget-friendly massage and firming oil available in a 300ml pump bottle for roughly £8.99 on Amazon.co.uk.
Application: Massage about half a teaspoon per limb into clean, damp skin after a bath or shower.
Target Areas: Focus on areas prone to dryness, tech neck, arms, thighs, or the décolletage.
Morning Routine: Always follow with SPF on exposed skin if applying during the day.

references.title: Alpha-H Firming Peptide Body Oil
references.snippet: Alpha-H Firming Peptide Body Oil is a high-performance treatment that helps improve the look of skin firmness, elasticity, and hydration. Infused with Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, this intelligent peptide supports the skin’s structural proteins to reduce the visible signs of ageing and enhance tone. Macadamia and Microalgae Oils deliver essential fatty acids and antioxidants to strengthen the skin barrier and restore smoothness. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly, leaving skin soft and refined with a subtle blend of vanilla and bergamot. Nourish, firm, and hydrate your skin with the Alpha-H Firming Peptide Body Oil. This luxurious, fast-absorbing body oil is infused with Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, a targeted peptide that helps minimise the look of fine lines and wrinkles while promoting smoother, firmer-looking skin. Powered by Omega-rich Macadamia Oil and Microalgae Oil, it deeply hydrates, restores elasticity, and helps support the skin’s natural collagen levels for improved tone and texture. The result is skin that feels soft, supple, and visibly rejuvenated. Light in texture yet rich in care, this oil absorbs quickly without residue, leaving behind a subtle hint of warm vanilla and a radiant, healthy glow. Ideal for all skin types, it can be used from neck to toe — especially on areas prone to dryness or early signs of ageing such as the neck, décolletage, and arms. Perfect for anyone seeking smoother, firmer, and more hydrated skin that looks as good as it feels.
